articles.title: Top BofA Analyst Raises Apple Stock (AAPL) Price Target Ahead of Q2 Earnings
articles.mainIdea: Top BofA Analyst Raises Apple Stock (AAPL) Price Target Ahead of Q2 Earnings
articles.summary: TipRanks: Top BofA Analyst Raises Apple Stock (AAPL) Price Target Ahead of Q2 Earnings. Apple (AAPL) stock is down 2% year-to-date due to concerns about higher input costs, tariffs, and the impact of macro uncertainty on consumer spending. Nonetheless, ahead of Apple’s Q2 FY26 earnings, AAPL bulls are optimistic about the stock, citing several positives, including a loyal iPhone customer base and innovative offerings like the new MacBook Neo. Interestingly, Top Bank of America analyst Wamsi Mohan reiterated a Buy rating on AAPL stock and raised his price target to $325 from $320. M Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, APC.
